title: How Leaving Christianity Saved My Life

top_liked.author: @Pontiacman1964
top_liked.text: When I left religion for good about 40 years ago, I began a life of no more fear. I also left behind judging others.

top_liked.author: @nancyviswanathan6296
top_liked.text: For me it wasn’t “leaving” Christianity, it was “escaping” Christianity. Unfortunately, the damage was done. But that’s where healing and support comes in. Thanks you, Darante

top_liked.author: @loretomazzola403
top_liked.text: "Value me as a human being, not through the lense of their imagination and their imaginary friend."👊

top_liked.author: @djfingersflores
top_liked.text: Damn Darante 580 pounds? .. I'm glad you slimmed down homie! We need you around for MANY more years  to come. Peace out !

top_liked.author: @kelseylyons7746
top_liked.text: It has changed my life by realizing that the kingdom of god is within ME. I am free. No more thinking I’m a worthless sinner that I was told I was. No more thinking I’m spending eternity in hell.

top_liked.author: @Deathhellandthegrave
top_liked.text: I was catholic, so leaving the faith has removed the anxiety and depression of being on my way to hell over and over. We can all die in peace. There is no hell.

top_liked.author: @Dark-Light.Bad-Guy
top_liked.text: Accepting that I am in control of my life empowered me to take control of my life. ❤

top_liked.author: @sharlane74
top_liked.text: When I left fundamentalist Christianity and started embracing spirituality, I met the love of my life. We’re getting married in October, I became more financially secure, and all the toxic people that were in my life are gone. I’m a much happier person. My children say they love…

top_liked.text: Wow! Good for you! What a transformation!
